responsibility: Implements sequential stream-file channels using FIO plus the shared RTgen/RTfio device machinery. It allocates a device id, opens files for reading or writing according to channel flags, installs generic text/raw/look/skip hooks into each DeviceTable, exposes stream-file validation and close operations through IOLink, and handles flushing, file closure, and errno-to-ISO error translation for ordinary stream-backed channels.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation companion to StreamFile.def, opening FIO files, allocating a device id, installing text/raw device handlers, translating open/close behavior, and validating stream-file channels.
